# paddle_notification (Data Source)

Look up an existing Paddle notification (one delivery attempt to a webhook endpoint or email destination), either directly by `id` or by `notification_setting_id`/`status` filters — the natural read-side companion to the `paddle_notification_setting` resource, which only configures *where* to deliver, not what was actually delivered or whether it succeeded. `logs` surfaces the actual HTTP response code and body Paddle recorded for each delivery attempt. See https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/notifications/overview. If `id` is set, every other filter is ignored and that notification is fetched directly. Otherwise, filters are applied server-side and exactly one notification must match — zero or more than one match is an error, not a silent first-result pick.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Paddle notification ID (`ntf_...`) to look up directly. Leave unset to look up by the other filters instead.
- `notification_setting_id` (String) Filter by the owning notification destination's ID (`ntfset_...`). Ignored if `id` is set.
- `status` (String) Filter by status: one of `not_attempted`, `needs_retry`, `delivered`, `failed`. Ignored if `id` is set. Also returned (computed) with the matched notification's actual status.

### Read-Only

- `delivered_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time this notification was delivered, or `null` if not yet delivered.
- `logs` (Attributes List) Every delivery attempt Paddle recorded for this notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))
- `occurred_at` (String)
- `times_attempted` (Number)
- `type` (String) Event type this notification carries, in `entity.event_type` format.

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `attempted_at` (String) RFC 3339 date-time Paddle attempted this delivery.
- `id` (String) Paddle notification log ID (`ntflog_...`).
- `response_body` (String)
- `response_code` (Number) HTTP status code the receiving server returned.
- `response_content_type` (String)
